canonical_title: Departure resistance to a sudden asymmetric loss of thrust

versions.title_at_revision: Departure resistance to a sudden asymmetric loss of thrust
versions.text:
Standard: Following sudden asymmetric loss of thrust from the most critical factor, a departure from controlled flight can be avoided. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's departure resistance following a sudden asymmetric loss of thrust as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Departure Avoidance Following Sudden Asymmetric Loss of Thrust paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's departure resistance following a sudden asymmetric loss of thrust as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Departure Avoidance Following Sudden Asymmetric Loss of Thrust paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's departure resistance following a sudden asymmetric loss of thrust as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Departure Avoidance Following Sudden Asymmetric Loss of Thrust paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
